body: Release versions are PATCH bumps by default (v0.14.0 -> v0.14.1, gqlkit-ts 0.3.0 -> 0.3.1), even for new features or breaking changes. Never choose a minor or major bump without the owner's explicit go-ahead; ask first and default to patch. Why: on 2026-10-13 a release jumped to gqlkit v0.14.0, gqlkit-sdl v0.12.0 and gqlkit-ts 0.3.0 when v0.13.1 / v0.11.1 / 0.2.1 were wanted; npm and the Go module proxy keep published versions forever, so the jump cannot be undone.
